text:
eva_customer: Hey support — trying to redeem promo code `PRO50-APR23` at checkout, but it errors with "Invalid/Expired". Account uses SSO (email shown as eva@Example.COM). It's definitely within the promo window. Can someone check?

support_jess: Hi @eva_customer, sorry about that. Please paste the exact code (thanks, did) and a screenshot if you can. Are you on trial or already upgraded?

eva_customer: Screenshot attached (imgur link). Account shows "Trial" in billing. I tried both web and curl against `/v1/checkout/redeem`. Same error.

support_jess: Escalating to billing to pull redemption logs. @billing_omar can you look for `PRO50-APR23` and any recent redeems?

billing_omar: Looking now. Found an entry: `PRO50-APR23` status=redeemed user_id=UA_9987 at 2024-04-10T12:02:43Z. The logged email for that user is `eva@example.com` (lowercase).

support_jess: Huh — @eva_customer you said your SSO shows `eva@Example.COM` with mixed case, right?

eva_customer: Yep, my SSO principal is `Eva@Example.COM` (capital E).

sre_dan: Quick note from infra: our promo service historically compared the incoming email header to the redemption owner with a case-sensitive compare. Normally everything is normalized to lowercase earlier in the flow, but we recently deployed a change to the SSO mapping that started preserving case for sessions created before 2024-09-01. That can create a mismatch.

support_jess: We have a trace for the checkout attempt. In the request headers the proxy forwarded `X-User-Email: Eva@Example.COM`. Promo service queried owner `eva@example.com` and did `==` compare -> mismatch -> returns 410.

sre_dan: Repro snippet from the trace (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/checkout/redeem HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-User-Email: Eva@Example.COM
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Body: { "code": "PRO50-APR23", "account_id": "UA_4421" }

promo-service: lookup owner for PRO50-APR23 -> "eva@example.com"
if (incoming_email == owner_email) -> false (case mismatch)
return 410, { "error": "invalid_or_expired" }
```

billing_omar: Given that, looks like the code was indeed redeemed earlier by a different canonicalization path (probably a test user) — but the customer did try to redeem and hit the compare bug. We can not reissue that same one-time code, but we can do a manual credit so the customer gets the discount.

support_jess: Ok. @eva_customer we'll apply a manual credit equivalent to the promo and follow up here. Can you confirm the invoice you want it applied to (current billing cycle)?

eva_customer: Yes please apply to current invoice. Really appreciate the quick help.

billing_omar: Manual credit applied: USD 50 (PRO50) to invoice INV-2024-2178. Invoice updated and payment adjusted.

sre_dan: Filed INF-2397 to normalize email comparisons in promo-service (lowercase everything at ingress) and to add unit tests + a migration job to reconcile existing promos that may have mismatched-case redeems.

support-boss: :thumbsup: (react)

support_jess: Closing this thread from support side — customer credited and fix ticket created. @sre_dan can you add rollout plan to INF-2397?

sre_dan: Will do. Also adding a query to find accounts with `X-User-Email` differing only by case from the canonical email, to catch other affected users.

support-bot: INF-2397 created by @sre_dan — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2397

eva_customer: Confirmed credit visible and discount applied. Thank you all! :smile:

support_jess: Thanks for the patience — marking resolved.
